name: NASA Citizen Science Projects
what_you_do: Join one of 49 NASA science projects online. Examples include classifying images or tracking clouds. You need only a phone or laptop.
who_can_apply: Open to everyone, and no citizenship is needed. Age rules vary by project: some (GLOBE Observer, NeMO-Net) are marked kid friendly; Growing Beyond Earth is for middle and high school teachers.
how_to_apply: Browse the project list, pick one, and follow that project's own sign-up steps.
notes: Some projects need a telescope or other gear. Projects are free to join.
